title: Ekadhika Purvena: By One More Than the Previous

data.name: Ekadhika Purvena
data.meaning: By One More Than the Previous

breakdown.purvena: than the previous/by the previous digit

data.principle: This sutra provides a shortcut for squaring numbers ending in 5, using the digit before 5. It is part of a system revived largely due to the efforts of Jagadguru Swami Bharathi Krishna Tirtha Ji.

data.narrative: Vedic Mathematics is a system of reasoning and mathematical working based on ancient Indian teachings called Veda. It originated from the 'Atharva Veda', the fourth Veda, which covers branches like Engineering, Mathematics, Sculpture, Medicine, and more. This subject was revived largely due to the efforts of Jagadguru Swami Bharathi Krishna Tirtha Ji of Govardhan Peeth, Puri Jaganath (1884-1960). Having researched the subject for years, even his efforts would have gone in vain but for the enterprise of some disciples who took down notes during his last days.
data.relevance: Vedic Mathematics simplifies arithmetic and algebraic operations, has increasingly found acceptance the world over. It is a fast, efficient, and easy-to-learn tool for those who need to solve mathematical problems faster by the day.

data.title: Why it Works (Algebraic Proof)
steps: Consider any number ending in 5 as (10a + 5).
This formula [a(a+1)]25 means: multiply the prefix 'a' by its successor 'a+1', and append 25 to the end.
